units.source_text: 翌日，我到学校去了，但还惦挂着柏木的身体。

en.t: The next day, I went to school, but I was still worried about Kashiwagi's condition.

units.source_text: 回想起来，我觉得那时候把他扔下逃跑回来，也是以友情为重的一种行为，并不感到负有什么责任，

en.t: Looking back, I felt that leaving him behind and running away then had also been an act that valued friendship, and I did not feel any sense of responsibility for it,

units.source_text: 可今天要是在教室里看不到他的身影，那就……

en.t: but if I did not see him in the classroom today, then...

units.source_text: 我不由得涌起一股不安的心绪。

en.t: A feeling of unease rose in me despite myself.

units.source_text: 快上课的时间，我看到柏木完全像往常一样，不自然地耸起肩膀，走进教室里来了。

en.t: Just before class was about to begin, I saw Kashiwagi come into the classroom exactly as usual, his shoulders raised unnaturally.
